phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Xebatên herêmî yên kurt, şert û mercên serbestberdanê bi polîsê xwe re kontrol bikin, hejmara telefonê tu caran nayê nîşandan.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Armancên lêborînê û planeke amadebûna xanî. Groundwork xanî peyda nake û bi dabînkeran re hevkarî nake. Ji bo alîkariya herêmî, bi telefonê 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Plana pereyî. Hîn nirx nehatiye diyarkirin.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Hûn dikarin li jorê her ekranê pêdivî bi alîkariyê jî bitikînin.

reentry.steps.step11.draft: 988 û 911 di telefona xwe de biparêzin

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Her roja dadgehê û serlêdanê li ser rojnameyekê binivîse

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Cezayê te, mûçeyên te û lêborînê kontrol bike

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Di Medicaidê de binivîse, û eger hewceyî wê be, SNAP

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Ciheke ewle ji bo dimînin bibînin (bi telefonê 211 an çavkaniyên xanî yên herêmî)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Xwarin ji bo vê hefteyê bibînin (bi telefonê 211 an xwarina xwarinê ya herêmî)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Pêşniyar  ⁇  ji bo nirxandinê. gavên pêşî yên aram ji bo 24 saetên pêşî piştî ku ji ber ku ji bo nirxandinê dê li vir xuya bibe.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Belgeyên te şîfrkirî ne. Plana pereyî heye; hêj nirx nehatiye diyarkirin.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Tu bi tenê nîne. Bişkoka krîzê li jor her dem li vir e  ⁇  di rewşeke awarte de telefon an text 988, an 911.
